question: 00_07 HW.25 (rain/dew stand §7 pp. 3–4) + HW.6 (install season, 01_04 §3.5): site climate inputs

inputs.climate: ERA5 via Open-Meteo archive, Cherkasy grid point 49.5N 32.0E, 1991-2020 (data/era5_cherkasy/README.md)
inputs.soil_threshold: Belokopytova et al. 2026, Plants 15:1933, doi:10.3390/plants15131933 — soil 20 cm ≥ 3.5 °C, lead 9.6 ± 1.1 d (Pinus sylvestris, Siberia)
inputs.air_thresholds: Rossi et al. 2008, Global Ecol. Biogeogr. 17:696, doi:10.1111/j.1466-8238.2008.00417.x — daily mean ≈ 8–9 °C at onset and end (7 conifer species)

ours.night_hours: 20:00-06:59 UTC+3 (Open-Meteo's fixed offset, no DST; in winter civil 19:00-05:59)
ours.crossing: sustained: spring = first day of the first run ≥ run_days after the last return below lasting ≥ run_days, searched to season_anchor_doy; autumn = the mirror

intensity_on_wet_days_mm_per_h.definition: daily sum / precipitation_hours on days with ≥ 1.0 mm — an hourly MEAN of that day

dew.criterion: night hour 20:00–06:59 UTC+3 (Open-Meteo's fixed offset, no DST; in winter civil 19:00–05:59) with T2m − Td ≤ 1.0 °C or RH ≥ 95.0 %; a night belongs to the date of its evening

soil_7_28cm_implied_cambial_onset.rule: spring crossing + 9.6 d (Belokopytova et al. 2026; their SE ± 1.1 d not swept)

soil_0_7cm_implied_cambial_onset.rule: spring crossing + 9.6 d (Belokopytova et al. 2026; their SE ± 1.1 d not swept)

ceilings: a ~0.25° reanalysis cell: downpours smoothed (intensity percentiles LOW), drizzle over-produced (≥ 0.1 mm fraction HIGH)
air at 2 m, not the coupon face or the bark: a radiating surface collects dew on more nights
open-field soil, not forest soil under canopy and litter, which warms later in spring
thresholds are of xylogenesis from other sites and climates, not of resin pressure (the subject of 01_04 §3.5)

crossing dates are as sharp as our rule (run_days, the anchor, «sustained»): a shorter return below is absorbed, a longer one moves the date; the sources dated onset and end from observed cambium, not from a temperature series, so another defensible rule moves these dates — the P10 and the earliest years most
the clock is a fixed UTC+3 (no DST): the night window 20:00–06:59 UTC+3 is civil 19:00–05:59 in winter, and daily rain sums and soil means are cut at UTC+3 midnight
rain_prose: Days with ≥ 1 mm: 27% (99.4 a year); on them the day's hourly-mean intensity has median 0.44 and P90 1.0 mm/h (max 4.6). ERA5 smooths downpours, so the percentiles are a LOWER bound on the intensity a coupon meets.
dew_prose: Dew nights (air criterion, T2m > 0 °C): 88.4 a year (24% of nights), median 5.0 h and P90 11.0 h of dew-point hours per such night; air at 2 m, not the coupon face.
season_prose: Soil 7–28 cm reaches 3.5 °C sustainedly (the first 5-day run after the last 5-day return below) at median 03-31 (P10–P90 03-18–04-06), implying cambial onset near 04-09 by the Siberian lead; daily mean air ≥ 8–9 °C sustainedly begins at median 04-07–04-17 and ends at 10-11–10-15. These are xylogenesis thresholds from other sites, not resin pressure, and open-field soil warms earlier than forest soil.
